# featbit_segment (Data Source)

Reads one active FeatBit Segment by exact Environment and Segment UUIDs.

The exact Segment UUID must be visible from the exact Environment UUID. Unlike
the resource, this data source can observe both `environment-specific` and
`shared` Segments. It is read-only and rejects archived objects or identity
mismatches rather than selecting another Segment.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "environment_id" {
  description = "Exact Environment UUID from which the Segment is visible."
  type        = string
}

variable "segment_id" {
  description = "Exact FeatBit Segment UUID."
  type        = string
}

data "featbit_segment" "exact" {
  environment_id = var.environment_id
  id             = var.segment_id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `environment_id` (String) Exact Environment UUID from which the Segment is visible.
- `id` (String) Exact Segment UUID.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) Segment description, canonicalized to an empty string when absent.
- `excluded_users` (Set of String) Exact user keys explicitly excluded from the Segment.
- `included_users` (Set of String) Exact user keys explicitly included in the Segment.
- `key` (String) Exact case-sensitive Segment key.
- `name` (String) Segment display name.
- `rules` (Attributes List) Ordered Segment rules. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rules))
- `scopes` (Set of String) Immutable fully qualified Segment scope RNs.
- `tags` (Set of String) Segment tags.
- `type` (String) Exact Segment type: `environment-specific` or `shared`.

<a id="nestedatt--rules"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rules`

Read-Only:

- `conditions` (Attributes List) Ordered conditions combined with logical AND. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rules--conditions))
- `id` (String) Rule UUID.
- `name` (String) Rule display name.

<a id="nestedatt--rules--conditions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rules.conditions`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) Condition UUID.
- `operator` (String) Exact documented condition operator.
- `property` (String) Exact user property name.
- `value` (String) Canonical operator value encoding.
